why: Raising the severity for cuts that omit an NP head made the model prefer cut positions that keep NP heads attached to the left span; that changed the top-ranked cut choices (drop in rank coincidence at depths 1–2) and thus shifted mass toward very-short segmentations (small bins ≤3 and ≤5 improved) while worsening many medium-length segmentations (≤7 and ≤10).
lesson: When increasing NP‑head preservation severity, watch per‑bin effects: preserve heads without systematically pushing top choices into cuts that fragment mid‑length spans or break coordinated/enumerative structures.
